assessment: This study reports of a new signaling pathway in hippocampal neurons by which α1 receptors for norepinephrine regulate Cav1.2 calcium channels; activation of α1 receptors enhances a form of long-lasting synaptic plasticity that is dependent on L-type calcium channels. The experiments are comprehensive and well-executed, and the main conclusions are compellingly supported by the data shown. The work has significance for the field of neuroscience in general and for cellular mechanisms of neuroregulation in particular.
